dimensions.n: <int> Number of item types to be produced.
dimensions.m: <int> Number of parallel machines available for production.
dimensions.p: <int> Number of planning periods in the horizon.

parameters.Cut: <float> Capacity utilization factor scaling total demand to determine base machine capacity.
parameters.CutVar: <float> Capacity variation factor controlling the spread of capacity across machines.
parameters.Theta: <int> Multiplier applied to setup times to compute the corresponding setup costs.
parameters.MProb: <float> Probability that each additional machine is eligible to produce a given item.
parameters.MBal: <float> Maximum allowed imbalance in the number of items assignable to any two machines, as a fraction of n.

demands: <list[list[int]], shape [n][p]> Quantity of each item that must be delivered in each period.
inventory_costs: <list[int], length n> Per-unit cost of holding one unit of each item in inventory for one period.
processing_time: <int> Time required to produce one unit of any item on any machine.
setup_times: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [n][n][m]> Time needed to change each machine from producing one item to another.
setup_costs: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [n][n][m]> Cost incurred when changing each machine from producing one item to another.
machine_capacities: <list[list[int]], shape [m][p]> Available production time on each machine in each period.
max_production: <list[list[int]], shape [n][p]> Maximum quantity of each item that can be produced from each period onward.
max_setups_per_item: <list[list[list[int]]], shape [n][m][p]> Maximum number of times each machine can be set up to produce a given item in a given period.
minimum_lot_sizes: <list[int], length n> Minimum production batch size required for each item when its setup is not carried over.
shortcut_items: <list[int], length ceil(n/10)> Indices of items with cleansing properties that reduce transition costs and times when used as intermediaries.
machine_eligibility: <list[list[int]], shape [n][m]> Whether each machine is allowed to produce each item (1 = eligible, 0 = not eligible).
